name: Energy vs Dollar: WTI & Natural Gas Correlation with DXY
description: Correlation research study examining the relationship between WTI crude oil, Henry Hub natural gas, and the US Dollar Index (DXY). Computes rolling correlations, scatter regressions, and full-period statistics (correlation, beta, R²) for WTI/DXY and NG/DXY.
source:
# Energy vs Dollar: WTI & Natural Gas Correlation with DXY
# Examines rolling and full-period correlations between energy commodities and the dollar
# WTI (CL) and Natural Gas (NG) vs US Dollar Index (DXY)
# Metrics: rolling correlation (20d, 60d), beta, R-squared, scatter regression

# ============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ============================================================================

# Primary futures data for CL and NG
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close_asset = cont.c

# DXY reference data (US Dollar Index futures — DX)
# reference_futures provides a continuous front-month series
dxy_src = reference_futures(ticker="DX")()
close_dxy = dxy_src.c

# ============================================================================
# DAILY RETURNS
# ============================================================================

ret_asset = returns(period=1)(close_asset)
ret_dxy = returns(period=1)(close_dxy)

# ============================================================================
# ROLLING CORRELATIONS vs DXY (20-day and 60-day)
# ============================================================================

corr_20d = rolling_corr(window=20, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_dxy, y=ret_asset)
corr_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.rolling, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_dxy, y=ret_asset)

# Full-period (expanding) correlation for summary stats
corr_expanding = rolling_corr(window=20, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=ret_dxy, y=ret_asset)

# R-squared = correlation^2
r_squared = corr_expanding ** 2

# ============================================================================
# BETA vs DXY (expanding window for full-period estimate)
# ============================================================================

beta_expanding = beta(window=500)(asset_returns=ret_asset, market_returns=ret_dxy)

# ============================================================================
# TIMESTAMPS FOR CROSS-SECTIONAL LINES
# ============================================================================

ts = index()()

# ============================================================================
# CHART 1: cs_lines — 60-day Rolling Correlation vs DXY
# Both WTI and NG on the same chart for comparison
# ============================================================================

cs_lines(
    title="60-Day Rolling Correlation vs DXY",
    category="1. Rolling Correlation",
    y_axis_label="Correlation",
    x_axis_label="Date",
    order=1
)(ts, corr_60d)

# ============================================================================
# CHART 2: xy_scatter — WTI Daily Returns vs DXY Daily Returns
# Per-asset scatter with regression line
# ============================================================================

xy_scatter(
    title="Daily Returns vs DXY (with Regression Line)",
    category="2. Scatter Analysis",
    x_axis_label="DXY Daily Return",
    y_axis_label="Asset Daily Return",
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name="Daily Returns", color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    show_trend_line=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="Zero")
    ]),
    order=2
)(x=ret_dxy, y_values=ret_asset)

# ============================================================================
# CHART 3: cs_summary_table — Full-Period Statistics
# Correlation, Beta, R-squared for WTI/DXY and NG/DXY side by side
# ============================================================================

cs_summary_table(
    title="Full-Period Statistics vs DXY",
    category="3. Summary Statistics",
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title="Full-Period Statistics vs DXY",
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Correlation", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title="R-Squared", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(title="Beta to DXY", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(corr_expanding, r_squared, beta_expanding)
